cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Hope with Me
cards.instruction: Recruit someone into believing that the outcome can still change, even when the evidence is thin.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've put a yellow tab on our cafe application like yours. Good news ready to celebrate. Help me choose our first glasses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yellow means awaiting a decision. We're still on the waiting list; I haven't told Mum.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, ready and waiting. Just choose with me. Which glasses would look right on our tables?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: These two. Mum would want a mug.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Choose hers too. Where would she sit when we open?
